title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
abstract: arXiv:2610.14707v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement

translated_title: 如何构建一个真正衡量品味的基准测试
translated_abstract: 专家对齐的“品味”基准应该奖励工艺判断力，而不是钻测试空子的能力。我们提出了TasteBench，这是一个涵盖视觉、品牌、书籍和技术项目的两两好坏对比基准，采用固定的评分标准且仅以专家标注作为黄金标准（评审小组n>=3；一致率>=0.60作为主要门槛；弱参与度标签仅用于训练/分析），同时配套一个能将工艺判断力与钻空子行为区分开来的对照协议。将该协议应用于第一轮试点（primary_human_expert；三位真人人类专家；n=250对样本）时，发现并量化了三种效度威胁：两个夸大平凡基线层的构建伪影，以及一个抬高所有分数的难度天花板。(1) 位置偏差：优选项目以0.956的概率出现在槽位A，因此“始终选择A”的策略可得分0.956（公平概率为0.5）。(2) 词汇泄露：仅凭一个文件名词汇线索即可得0.912分。(3) 难度天花板：工艺领域显示出接近天花板的人类一致性。
tldr: 该论文提出TasteBench——一个测量真实品味判断力的两两对比基准，并通过对照协议揭示并量化了基准测试中的三种效度威胁：位置偏差、词汇泄露和难度天花板。
